definitions: A ragtime composition for piano by Scott Joplin, published in 1899.
One of Joplin's earliest compositions, it became one of the most famous of all ragtime pieces and was a significant influence on the development of the genre.
examples: The band played a lively rendition of the Maple Leaf Rag.
Many pianists consider the Maple Leaf Rag a cornerstone of ragtime repertoire.
